data.body: Phase-2 RED evidence. Held-out workflow plus fixture-scale oracles were collected and executed under pytest before any repair. Exact command: pytest tests/unit/test_build_provenance_fixture_scale.py tests/unit/test_artifact_probe_workflow.py -vv -p no:cacheprovider. Result: 0 passed / 3 failed for the intended mechanisms. Fixture oracle observed 3,019 tracked files versus the three-input production-hook boundary. Workflow build oracle could not find post-checkout REBAR_EXPECTED_COMMIT from git rev-parse --short HEAD and still found the GITHUB_SHA build. Installed-artifact oracle found zero exact-equality probes rather than two. The two oracle files are removed from the shared worktree and retained held-out by the orchestrator; the visible helper seam still preserves baseline whole-tree behavior. collected: yes; executed: yes; skips/xfails: zero; gate: default pytest plus Gerrit Verify.
